p.i: Haec damus vbi nec tamen pusilla,
Rustica quem donis reuerentur numina, silvis
Faunos in melius properantis pignora sacli
Responsa ferre caelitum rex hac iubet:
Omnis in hunc rerum consensit machina regem,
Non forte lectum aut lege, sed facto datum.
Non aliter quam natura nouere magistra,
Ni forte malis auios per anfractus

page.notes: Woodcut-like decorative initials at the verse openings; a printed mark "V A" at lower right is treated as a catchword-like mark. Some words in the scan are faint and marked by my reading of the verse; no marginal notes are visible.
